_comment: Pre-encoded 4ch (FOA) latents for the Qwen Text->Spatial DiT. PLACEHOLDER PATH: pre-encoding has NOT been run yet. It depends on the refined captions produced by the data pipeline (e.g. ${AMBIT_DATA_ROOT}/spatial_foa/captions_stage1_refined.jsonl); once captions are finalized, run pre_encode_4ch.py with the 4ch VAE to populate this directory.
